title: Handle no value
summary: Kotlin: Handle no value. Use the name Asha.
introduction: A question mark makes a type nullable. ?: supplies a fallback for null.

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Kotlin. Save lesson.kt, run kotlinc lesson.kt -include-runtime -d lesson.jar, then java -jar lesson.jar.

blocks.title: Handle no value

blocks.text: The nullable name is null. The ?: operator chooses Guest.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The !! operator can crash when the value is null.
